Usage: aeat app ledger import [OPTIONS]                                       
                                                                               
 Import bank statements or records into the accounting ledger                  
                                                                               
┌─ Options ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ *  --file                 <path>                   Path to the bank         │
│                                                    statement file or        │
│                                                    directory                │
│                                                    [required]               │
│ *  --provider             <auto|csv|ofx|qfx|xlsx|  Statement format         │
│                           excel|n26|pdf|pdf-n26>   provider. Recognised     │
│                                                    values: auto, csv, ofx,  │
│                                                    qfx, xlsx, excel, n26,   │
│                                                    pdf, pdf-n26             │
│                                                    [required]               │
│    --dry-run                                       Run the import in        │
│                                                    dry-run mode (without    │
│                                                    saving)                  │
│    --verify                                        Verify entries after     │
│                                                    import                   │
│    --verify-source        <path>                   Original file used to    │
│                                                    verify imported rows.    │
│    --verbose                                       Show detailed            │
│                                                    information during       │
│                                                    import                   │
│    --period               <str>                    Filing period as an AEAT │
│                                                    token: 1T-4T (quarters), │
│                                                    0A (annual), 01-12       │
│                                                    (months). Combine with   │
│                                                    --year to choose the     │
│                                                    year.                    │
│    --year                 <int>                    Filing year for --period │
│                                                    (e.g. 2024).             │
│    --help                                          Show this message and    │
│                                                    exit.                    │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
